learnings.title: GitHub changelog: BYOK and enterprise custom models in the Copilot usage API
learnings.claim: GitHub changelog page 2026-11-03-byok-and-enterprise-custom-models-in-the-copilot-usage-api (dated November 3, 2026; feed pubDate Wed, 04 Nov 2026 00:32:19 +0000; read 2026-11-05) states the Copilot usage metrics API now separates BYOK usage: local BYOK (Copilot CLI / Copilot app to a developer's own provider key or local model) via used_local_byok, totals_by_local_byok (by byok_kind and surface) and daily/weekly/monthly_active_local_byok_users; enterprise custom models via a new boolean is_custom_enterprise_model on totals_by_client[].totals_by_model[]. Existing totals are unchanged, local BYOK counts are a telemetry-based lower bound, there is no backfill, and access needs the View Copilot Metrics permission with the usage metrics policy enabled.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: only relevant if the system plan reads Copilot usage metrics (earlier learning on totals_by_client); no code or operational change without approval.
learnings.next_measurement: Record yes/no before 2026-11-12 whether any system workflow consumes Copilot usage metrics and would benefit from is_custom_enterprise_model or totals_by_local_byok.

learnings.title: Shopify changelog: currententrychange event.from returns the previous page in customer account full-page extensions (2027-01)
learnings.claim: Shopify developer changelog entry dated October 31, 2026 (Version 2027-01, flags Breaking API Change and Action required; read 2026-11-05) states that starting in API version 2027-01, in customer account full-page extensions (customer-account.page.render and customer-account.order.page.render) the Navigation API currententrychange event sets event.from to the page navigated away from instead of the new page; 2026-10 and earlier are unchanged. Code reading the new page from event.from.url must switch to shopify.navigation.currentEntry.url (works on 2025-10 and later); extensions using shopify.navigation.currentEntry or useNavigationCurrentEntry are unaffected.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: applies only if the video_shopify plan ships a customer account full-page extension; no change without approval.
learnings.next_measurement: Record yes/no before 2026-11-12 whether any Shopify app in the video_shopify plan has a customer account full-page extension reading event.from.
